lines.1: 「Hello, young lady. (Purely a courtesy.) Pardon the intrusion.」
lines.2: 「Sorry to put you through this every day, Leo. All for that dud of mine.」
lines.3: 「If I abandon her, I think her life will be over.」
lines.4: 「Would you take that thing off my hands and marry her?」
lines.5: 「I'd rather not marry a moron who gave herself an ear infection by getting too hooked on cleaning her ears.」
lines.6: 「Can't blame you. If I were a man, I wouldn't touch her with a ten-foot pole either.」
